text:
Anika: Short follow-up from the recent KV-cache regression. Goal: a tight action list, owners, and quick checks so we can close the postmortem. Weekly status until metrics show stable.

Tom: I can own the reproducer + CI stress test. I found a small stress that causes sustained RSS creep when eviction and compaction overlap. Will add to stress-suite. ETA: 48h.

Rafael: I’ll take runtime mitigation: stop compaction during eviction windows and add a fast pre-evict that prefers low-hit prefixes. Plan a canary (compaction_disabled=true) for 24h. ETA: 36h.

Yvonne: I’ll add fragmentation telemetry + a dashboard. Metric: fragmentation_ratio and churn_score per prefix_bucket. Also wire alert to PagerDuty when fragmentation_ratio > 0.2 for 3h. ETA: 72h.

Anika: Please post compact action items we can mark in the postmortem.

Tom: Action 1 (Tom) - add CI reproducible test that randomizes eviction/compaction timing and fails if RSS grows >20% after 10m of steady load. Verification: test green in CI. ETA: 48h.

Rafael: Action 2 (Rafael) - PR to gate compaction during eviction windows, add unit tests for concurrency. Deploy canary and measure RSS. Verification: canary runs 24h without OOM. ETA: 36h.

Yvonne: Action 3 (Yvonne) - dashboard with top-20 alloc_sites and prefix_bucket breakdown; add churn_score alert and runbook linking to pprof capture steps. Verification: dashboard live + alert test. ETA: 72h.

Anika: Action 4 (Anika) - short-term guard: per-shard hard cap at 90% with quarantine after 3 restarts; add annotation to exempt test shards. Verification: PR merged and canary enforces cap. ETA: 24h.

Tom: Reproducer snippet I used:
```
spawn_putters(50)
periodically { evict(random_hot_prefixes()); compact(); }
observe(rss)
```
I’ll push harness to repo and link CI.

infra-bot: created alert rule kvcache_frag_hotspots -> fires when fragmentation_ratio > 0.2 for 3h; pagerduty: on-call -> infra lead.

Yvonne: Add tags: shard, zone, git_rev, prefix_hash to all telemetry. Also include last_restart_count in alert context.

Rafael: Canary deploy kicked: kvcache-canary-21 (compaction_disabled=true) - build 2026.07.14-rc2.

Tom: Uploading initial pprof captures: s3://redwood-profiles/1990012345/tom-pprof-1.pb.gz. Will add alloc_site labels.

Anika: Who will do weekly check-ins? Need rotation and minutes posting.

Rafael: I can take the first two weeks. I’ll post minutes in this thread.

Tom: Once CI reproducer is in, we can treat regression as blocked until test passes. Will link PR when ready.

Anika: Thanks. Keep the postmortem action table updated with PR links and status (todo/in-progress/done). I’ll produce a one-page exec note after first canary metrics. :thumbsup:
